title: One request through IAM
claim: A role gives temporary credentials, and the policies are evaluated each time a request is made.
alt: A sequence with three participants: a principal, AWS STS and Amazon S3. The principal asks AWS STS to assume a role. AWS STS checks the trust policy and returns temporary credentials. The principal signs a request to Amazon S3 with them. AWS evaluates the policies, and Amazon S3 returns the object or an access denied error.

messages.label: AssumeRole
messages.say: The principal asks AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to assume a role.

messages.label: Check trust
messages.say: AWS STS checks that the trust policy of the role names the principal.

messages.label: Credentials
messages.say: AWS STS returns temporary security credentials that expire.

messages.label: GetObject
messages.say: The principal signs a request to Amazon S3 with the temporary credentials.

messages.label: Evaluate
messages.say: AWS evaluates the policies that apply, and an explicit deny overrides an explicit allow.

messages.label: Object or deny
messages.say: Amazon S3 returns the object, or an access denied error.
